description_en: Removes one or more secondary private IP addresses from an Elastic Network Interface (ENI)
description_zh: 从一张弹性网卡删除一个或多个辅助私有IP地址
kebab_example: aliyun ecs unassign-private-ip-addresses --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --network-interface-id eni-bp67acfmxazb4ph0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UnassignPrivateIpAddresses

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the resource. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 资源所属地域。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Elastic Network Interface (ENI)
parameters.name: network_interface_id

parameters.help_en: One or more secondary private IP addresses to remove
parameters.help_zh: 一个或多个需要删除的辅助私有IP地址
parameters.name: private_ip_address

parameters.help_en: One or more IPv4 prefixes to remove
parameters.help_zh: 一个或多个需要删除的IPv4前缀
parameters.name: ipv4_prefix
